      "type": "suggestion",

      "text": "Avoid sending prefilled extrapool transactions back to the peers that announced them",
      "quote": "We can reduce a bit of redundancy by not sending them again to the peers that announced them to us.",

      "status": "answered",

      "type": "suggestion",

      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "style",
      "text": "Prefer WITH_LOCK when reading send_state",

      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author applied the suggestion",

        "rc:3516788147"

    {
      "id": "rc:3486512370",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Hoist cb_fut and prefilled_cb_fut out to release m_most_recent_block_mutex before executing syscalls",
      "quote": "I think we can hoist cb_fut and prefilled_cb_fut out and copy the shared futures while m_most_recent_block_mutex is held, then release the lock for the rest of this method.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author released the lock earlier",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3516788330"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3516788330",
      "status_by_quote": "Nice! Much better to not hold a lock that prevents block updates while doing syscalls!!"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3521114497",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Avoid switching serialization launch policy from deferred to async",

      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "reviewer edited to note eager background serialization makes sense for prefill, and author asked if resolved",

        "rc:3583336244"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3583336244",

      "type": "question",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "When will the block hash in prefill_candidates differ from hash, and can they be merged?",

      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "style",
      "text": "Remove duplicate logging of window_size and bytes_available",

      "status_note": "author removed the caller-side logging",

        "rc:3583341542"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3583341542",
      "status_by_quote": "Ok, I removed it on the caller side."

    {
      "id": "rc:3521178456",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Seeding prefill candidates with the coinbase forces unnecessary TCP syscalls and prefill branch execution even when no extra transactions are prefilled",
      "quote": "In that case, the check in net_processing for prefill_candidates.size() > 0 is always true, so we will always go through the prefill path and do all the syscalls even for the current behavior of alway",

      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author changed the condition to require more than one candidate",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3583340609"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3583340609",
      "status_by_quote": "Great catch, thank you, I took this by changing the check to be prefill_candidates.size() > 1"

    {
      "id": "rc:3521842667",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Avoid taking and releasing m_send_mutex multiple times by returning early",
      "quote": "we should take m_send_mutex lock and return the value if send_state != SendState::v1, and then return the fallback after releasing the lock.",

      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author refactored lock handling and header size method",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3583339698"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],

      "status_by_id": "rc:3583339698",
      "status_by_quote": "Taken thanks, this also made me realize GetMessageHeaderSize shouldn't be virtual, public, or take a lock, so fixed that"

      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",

      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3669124325",
      "status_by_quote": "I'll let both my comments open, although I see they are fixed in #35724."
    },

      "type": "objection",
